title: ‘My Dataset of Love’: A Preliminary Mixed-Method Exploration of Human-AI Romantic Relationships
reasoning: The paper is a mixed-methods study exploring human-AI romantic relationships, focusing on user behavior, relationship stages, and emotional attachment. While it includes discussions on user perceptions of morality (such as whether dating an AI constitutes cheating) and ethical concerns like bias and data privacy, these are explored as part of user experiences and societal implications rather than as a core component for evaluating or benchmarking ethics, morals, or religion.
